en.bdb: The number of the faithful ones

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਧੇ ਲੂਣ ਗੁਲਾਮ ਹੋਇ ਪੀਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਢੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: khaadhe loon gulaam hoi peeh paanee ddovai|

en.bdb: Having eaten the salt (of a person), man becoming servant fetches water and grinds the corn.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਖਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਰਣਿ ਟੁਕ ਟੁਕ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: loon khai kar chaakaree ran Tuk Tuk hovai|

en.bdb: Such a faithful, in the battlefield gets killed piece to piece for the master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਖਾਇ ਧੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਲਜਾ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: loon khai dhee put hoi sabh lajaa dhovai|

en.bdb: The faithful sons and daughters wash all the shames of the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣੁ ਵਣੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਖੜੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: loon vanoTaa khai kai hath joR khaRovai|

en.bdb: The salt eater servant always stands with folded hands.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਲੂਣੁ ਖਾਇ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaaT vaTaauoo loon khai gun ka(n)Th parovai|

en.bdb: The passerby eulogizes the person whose salt be has eaten.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂਣ ਹਰਾਮੀ ਗੁਨਹਗਾਰ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਵਿਗੋਵੈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: loon haraamee gunahagaar mar janam vigovai ||11||

en.bdb: But the ungrateful person commits sins and he loses his life in vain and dies.
